basicInfo.name: Aris
basicInfo.flavor: As one of the five members of the Pentagon, she is consistently active on the front lines. The more she draws upon the earth dragon's power, the more yellow smoke seeps from her body, earning her battlefield moniker of \"Earthen Aura.\

Normal Attack.desc:
Single Enemy
 - Deals damage equal to 120% of Physical Attack plus 41% of target's Defense 1 time(s).
 - 40% chance to inflict Stun. [Duration: 1 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 120% of Physical Attack.
 - Increases Damage: To 41% of Magic Attack.

Skill 1.name: Crushing Strike
Skill 1.desc:
Single Enemy
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 70% of Physical Attack.
 - Increases Damage: To 24% of Magic Attack.
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Adds Effect: Activates again up to 1 time(s) with 100% power upon defeating an enemy with this skill.

Skill 2.name: Finishing Blow
Skill 2.desc:
All Enemies
 - Deals damage equal to 40% of Physical Attack plus 28% of target's Defense 3 time(s).
 - 45% chance to inflict Stun. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 40% of Physical Attack.
 - Increases Damage: To 28% of Magic Attack.

Passive.name: Earthen Aura
Passive.desc:
Self
 - Revives with 100% HP upon falling in battle. [Once per Battle]
 - Awakening Gauge Boost increases to 3 upon performing any attack 1 time(s).
 - All Allies
 - Grants Block Rate Boost. [Always Active]
 - Grants Quintuple-Target Attack Resistance [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - All Allies
 - Adds Effect: Grants a Barrier equal to 52% of the caster's Physical Attack upon using a skill 1 time(s). [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]
